versions.title: Streaming lakehouse on Databricks
versions.summary: Streaming tables that read each new file once, silver kept to the latest row per key with checks, and gold materialised views, retried and alerted on failure.

versions.title: Local medallion on DuckDB
versions.summary: Bronze tables loaded in full from CSV files and a silver table that keeps the latest row per key, all in one DuckDB file on a laptop.
